skill.summary: Manage Bring! shopping lists via the unofficial bring-shopping Node.js library using email/password login. Use for listing lists, reading items, adding/removing items, and checking/unchecking items when API-style access is acceptable.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the bring-shopping skill.
- Manage Bring! shopping lists using the unofficial bring-shopping Node.js library.
- Supports listing shopping lists, reading, adding, removing, checking, and unchecking items via CLI.
- Authenticates with Bring! using email and password; credentials should be stored in environment variables.
- Defaults to the "Willig" list unless otherwise specified.
